===Levels 45–55: Camelot Teleport===
Repeatedly casting [[Camelot Teleport]] offers around 80,000 experience per hour, with 55.5 experience per cast. Training from level 45 to 55 requires a total of 1,895 law runes, which costs {{Coins|-{{GEP|Law rune|1}}*1895 round 0}} assuming a [[staff of air]] is equipped.
